answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 21597 Country: India Title: some one told me that the meaning of my name ARQAM and my brother AKSAM is not corect weather it is true or false? Question: assalamualikum, some one told me that the meaning of my name ARQAM and my brother AKSAM is not corect weather it is true or false? Answer ID: 21597 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 661/661/M=1431) Arqam means: a type of viperous snake, spotted snake. Aksam means: broad way ( مصباح اللغات ). Aksam name is right. Arqam is the name of a sahabi, hence this name too is right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
